    Extract mean/median spectra for a spectral cube

    Source: R/extract.R
    at_extract_spectrum.Rd

    Extract mean/median spectra for a spectral cube

    Usage

    at_extract_spectrum(
  project,
  img = NULL,
  stat = "mean",
  layer = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  level = 0L,
  call = rlang::caller_env(),
  nonfinite = c("propagate", "omit", "error")
)

    Arguments

    project

    An annot_project.

    img

    An annot_image; defaults to the project's image. Supplying an alternate image asserts spatial registration on the same level-0 pixel grid. Its level-0 extent must match; differing pyramid dimensions are handled using the alternate image's actual level dimensions.

    stat

    "mean" (default) or "median".

    layer, label

    Optional filters.

    level

    Integer pyramid level. Default 0.

    call

    The calling environment, for error reporting.

    nonfinite

    Policy for NA, NaN and infinite samples: "propagate" (default) returns NA statistics for any affected ROI/band; "omit" uses finite samples only; "error" aborts on selected nonfinite samples. n always counts selected pixels. A wholly invalid selection has NA statistics under omit (including sum); singleton sample SD is NA.

    Value

    The long tibble of at_extract(), restricted to spectral bands and sorted by ROI, declared unit, wavelength, then band index. Values are not converted between units; equal wavelengths retain band order.

    See also

    Other extraction: at_extract(), at_extract_pixels()

    Examples

    cube <- at_example_image("cube")
proj <- at_project(cube, at_layer_add(at_layer("roi"),
                                      at_roi_circle(16, 16, 5, label = "roi")))
at_extract_spectrum(proj)
#> # A tibble: 40 × 12
#>    roi_id        layer label  band band_name wavelength unit  stat   value  n_px
